evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: I just have questions regarding the move and this could take ten to fifteen minutes of your time. So, is this a good time to talk to move? [Customer says yes, but rep did not wait for explicit confirmation of the full framing — rushed slightly.]
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Whit Lewis), move date (October 22nd Thursday), pickup (12000 South I-H 35 service road, Georgetown), delivery (10500 south interstate 35 frontage road, Austin), size (1050 sq ft two-bedroom apartment) all confirmed.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Before you proceed and asking details about the apartment. I just like to know aside from the pricing. Do you have any other concerns about the moving process? [Asked after the quid pro quo was already delivered, but before major logistics probing began.]
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer stated 'my main concern is like moving over my bigger things' — rep acknowledged but did not probe deeper with 'tell me more about that' or similar follow-up.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection back of concerns. Rep acknowledged the customer's worry about bigger items and TV but never summarized: 'So what I'm hearing is...'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floor (third floor), stories (implied multi-story with elevator), number of rooms (two bedroom), walking distance (three apartments to elevator), additional rooms (balcony), special considerations (TV 75 inches, couch U-shaped with ottoman, two beds to disassemble, bar stools), no workout equipment/safe/piano/art/appliances — extensive detail.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: And normally for a two bedroom apartment we see 25 to 35 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Never explicitly asked 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?' — customer mentioned 'four kind of medium large boxes' they'd have, but rep did not offer packing service.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Normally for a two bedroom apartment we finished the move-in five and a half hours but in your case... estimated to finish in five hours to six hours... The estimated cost for your move is $1,079 to $1,262 [Range given]. Personalized to elevator access on both ends, large 75-inch TV requiring extra care, and drive time. Fully anchored and personalized.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Here at Einstein no heat and fees of anytime, no credit card fees, no terrible fees. No just assemble or we assemble fees... we do have a travel fee of $110... everything is included to that gas and truck taxes insurance. All the wraps and pads... [Fee transparency present.] No explicit mention of '2.5-hour minimum' or '15-minute increments' commitment language or 'not a guess' framing — partial.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Customer immediately responded with 'I think I'll probably look somewhere else cause there's a lot of places with like 280 for the first two hours and stuff so I'm just gonna keep looking.' Rep did not ask for confirmation or objection-handling.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: we have the on time guarantee if we cannot make it at the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of the final bill. [Covers discount terms in recognizable form — fully delivered.]
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: we do have the no worry damage coverage. So this can actually cover you up to $2,000 per move if there are any accidental damages. [Mentions $2,000 coverage but does not explicitly state 'no deductible / no fine print' or confirm it's built into the rate, not an add-on — partial.]
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No follow-up question like 'Does that put those to rest?' after the Two Promises were delivered.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Never asked. Customer objected to price and said they would look elsewhere; rep said 'I see. Alright. Well thank you for considering. I'm fine. Have a good day.' and ended call.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' — customer volunteered an objection and the rep accepted it without attempting a close.

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details across all seven discovery items (property type, floors, rooms, walking distance, special items, TV size, furniture breakdown), creating a personalized and detailed estimate that showed strong technical mastery of the move profile.
coaching_note: After pricing was presented, the customer objected on cost; instead of asking 'Does that feel fair?' to create space for dialogue, or exploring the objection, the rep accepted the no and ended the call—always ask for the business explicitly and handle objections before giving up.
